name: Feature Grid 3D Representation
definition: A continuous volumetric field representation where every queried 3D position x returns a volume density σ(x) and a multi-channel feature F(x) ∈ R^C instead of an RGB color.
summary: Feature Grid 3D Representation decouples geometry from high-dimensional features using a memory-efficient grid, enabling full-resolution rendering that eliminates multi-view inconsistency and aliasing artifacts.
